2610.11025.title: Intent Graph: Navigating the Analytical Reasoning Space for Exploratory Data Analysis
2610.11025.paper_summary: Exploratory data analysis (EDA) is rarely open-ended in practice: analysts work from high-level domain questions toward the concrete analyses that can answer them, prioritizing directions with domain knowledge and prior hypotheses. Large language models (LLMs) can supply such knowledge, but their responses are unstructured, leaving analysts no way to see what has been explored, what is missing, or why one direction was chosen over another. We present DAG-EDA, a system that lets analysts and an LLM co-navigate the space of possible analyses through two linked structures. An intent graph, governed by a grammar of analytical intent, decomposes an ambiguous natural-language question into progressively concrete analysis tasks, keeping alternative framings open and letting analysts branch, backtrack, and compare paths. A multi-layered knowledge graph externalizes the LLM's domain knowledge, linking domain concepts to the dataset variables that can measure them, so analysts can inspect and contest how their question is grounded in the data. Both graphs are constructed from only the dataset and the analyst's question, and the analyses the analyst reaches are rendered as interactive dashboards. We illustrate the system through a usage scenario and describe a user study design for examining whether the system scaffold analysts' reasoning and navigation.
2610.11025.paper_summary_zh: 探索性數據分析（EDA）在實踐中很少是開放式的：分析師從高層次的領域問題出發，朝著可以回答這些問題的具體分析方向前進，並根據領域知識和先前的假設來優先考慮方向。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以提供這樣的知識，但它們的回應是非結構化的，讓分析師無法看到已經探索過的內容、缺失的部分或為何選擇某一方向而非另一個方向。我們提出了DAG-EDA，一個讓分析師和LLM共同導航可能分析空間的系統，通過兩個相互連結的結構實現。意圖圖由分析意圖的語法控制，將模糊的自然語言問題分解為逐步具體的分析任務，保持替代框架的開放性，讓分析師可以分支、回溯和比較路徑。一個多層次的知識圖將LLM的領域知識外部化，將領域概念與可以測量它們的數據集變量連接起來，讓分析師能夠檢查和質疑他們的問題如何根植於數據中。這兩個圖僅由數據集和分析師的問題構建而成，分析師所達到的分析結果以互動儀表板的形式呈現。我們通過一個使用場景來說明該系統，並描述一個用戶研究設計，以檢驗該系統是否能支撐分析師的推理和導航。
